vachanas.kannada:
ಅಂಗದ ಹೊಲಬನರಿದಲ್ಲದೆ
ಲಿಂಗದ ನೆಲೆಯನರಿಯಬಾರದು.
ಲಿಂಗದ ನೆಲೆಯನರಿದಲ್ಲದೆ
ನಿಜನಿರ್ಣಯವ ತಿಳಿಯಬಾರದು.
ನಿಜನಿರ್ಣಯವ ತಿಳಿದಲ್ಲದೆ ತನ್ನ ತಾನರಿಯಬಾರದು.
ಗುರುಕರುಣದಿಂದ ತನ್ನ ತಾನರಿದ ಶರಣಂಗೆ
ಅಂಗಕ್ಕೆ ಆಚಾರವಿಲ್ಲ, ಲಿಂಗಕ್ಕೆ ಕುರುಹಿಲ್ಲ.
ಗುರುಬಸವೇಶನೆಂಬುದಕ್ಕೆ ಕುರುಹು ಮುನ್ನಿಲ್ಲ.
vachanas.transliteration:
aṅgada holabanaridallade
liṅgada neleyanariyabāradu.
liṅgada neleyanaridallade
nijanirṇayava tiḷiyabāradu.
nijanirṇayava tiḷidallade tanna tānariyabāradu.
gurukaruṇadinda tanna tānarida śaraṇaṅge
aṅgakke ācāravilla, liṅgakke kuruhilla.
gurubasavēśanembudakke kuruhu munnilla.
vachanas.translation:
Unless one realizes the field of the body,
One cannot realize the abode of the Liṅga.
Unless one realizes the abode of the Liṅga,
One cannot know the true certainty of Reality.
Unless one knows that true certainty, one cannot know one's own Self.
For the Śaraṇa who has realized the Self through the Guru's grace,
There is no external observance for the body, and no distinguishing mark for the Liṅga.
The state called Guru Basavēśa has no mark preceding it.

vachanas.kannada:
ಗುರು ಪರಬ್ರಹ್ಮಮಗಣಿತಮಗೋಚರಂ.
ಗುರು ಪರಂ ಜ್ಞಾನಮಾನಂದರೂಪಂ.
ಗುರು ಪರಮತೇಜ ಬೀಜಾದಿ ಪಂಚಾಕ್ಷರಂ.
ಗುರು ಪಾದಕೋಟ್ಯಷ್ಟ ತೀರ್ಥಂಗಳಂ.
ಗುರು ವಚನರಚನ ಉಪದೇಶ ಮಂತ್ರಂ.
ಗುರು ಭಕ್ತಿ ಮುಕ್ತಿ ಮೋಕ್ಷ ಕಾರಣ ಇಹಪರಂ.
ಗುರು ಘನತರದ ಮಹಿಮೆಯನು ಗುರುಬಸವನೆ ಬಲ್ಲ
vachanas.transliteration:
guru parabrahmamagaṇitamagōcaraṁ.
guru paraṁ jñānamānandarūpaṁ.
guru paramatēja bījādi pan̄cākṣaraṁ.
guru pādakōṭyaṣṭa tīrthaṅgaḷaṁ.
guru vacanaracana upadēśa mantraṁ.
guru bhakti mukti mōkṣa kāraṇa ihaparaṁ.
guru ghanatarada mahimeyanu gurubasavane balla
vachanas.translation:
The Guru is the Supreme Brahman—immeasurable and beyond perception.
The Guru is the Supreme Knowledge, the very embodiment of Bliss.
The Guru is the Supreme Radiance, the Seed of the Pañcākṣarī Mantra.
At the Guru's feet abide crores upon crores of sacred tīrthas.
The Guru's words, teachings, and instructions are the true Mantra.
The Guru is the cause of devotion, liberation, and mokṣa, both in this world and the next.
The immeasurable glory of the Guru is known only to Guru Basava.

vachanas.kannada:
ಮೋನವೇನೊ ಮೂಲಮಂತ್ರ ಮುಖದಲ್ಲಿರಲು?
ಆಹ್ವಾನವೇನೂ ನಿಜ ಪರಿಪೂರ್ಣ ತನ್ನೊಳಗಿರಲು
ಧ್ಯಾನವೇನೊ ಸಹಜಧ್ಯಾನದ ಬೆಳಗೊಳಗೊಂಡವಂಗೆ?
ಜಪವೆಂದೇನೊ ತಾನು ತಾನಾದವಂಗೆ
ಬಯಲನರಸುವ ಮರುಳರಂತೆ ಗುರುಬಸವ.
vachanas.transliteration:
mōnavēno mūlamantra mukhadalliralu?
āhvānavēnū nija paripūrṇa tannoḷagiralu
dhyānavēno sahajadhyānada beḷagoḷagoṇḍavaṅge?
japavendēno tānu tānādavaṅge
bayalanarasuva maruḷarante gurubasava.
vachanas.translation:
What need is there for silence, when the Root Mantra already abides upon the lips?
What need is there for invocation, when the truly Perfect One abides within oneself?
What need is there for meditation, for one who is immersed in the radiance of natural meditation?
What need is there for japa, for one who has become the Self itself?
Only the deluded continue searching for the Infinite as though it were elsewhere, O Guru Basava.
